title: Broken
grading: The task page publishes the submission format and scoring details. Sign in to check whether this archived round accepts submissions.

statement.detail: Broken. Classify tile pairs by whether they come from the same photo and by their relative placement.

data.detail: The task lists 60 whole training photos, 320 test tiles, pairs CSV, and a starter kit with 240 labeled validation tiles and validation_data.csv.

materials.submission: Use the sample CSV and the organizer’s submit form. An account is required, and replay access may depend on the round.

metric: Macro F1 on binary same-photo labels (40 points) and six-way tile relationships (60). Use the starter’s validation pairs for local practice.

title: The Lost Laboratory Journal
grading: The task page publishes the submission format and scoring details. Sign in to check whether this archived round accepts submissions.

statement.detail: The Lost Laboratory Journal. Regenerate synthetic sensor features from the missing lab notes, then predict readings.

data.detail: The task lists surviving targets, test data, sample output, and the reconstruction instructions.

materials.submission: Use the sample CSV and the organizer’s submit form. An account is required, and replay access may depend on the round.

metric: RMSE. The judge maps 10.0 to the baseline and RMSE at or below 1.5 to 100 points.

title: RNA Profile
grading: The task page publishes the submission format and scoring details. Sign in to check whether this archived round accepts submissions.

statement.detail: RNA Profile. Predict one continuous value per position in the competition’s simulated sequences.

data.detail: Train and test sequences and a sample output are listed. Training examples include the simulated profile.

materials.submission: Use the sample CSV and the organizer’s submit form. An account is required, and replay access may depend on the round.

metric: Mean Pearson correlation across sequences. Invalid rows receive zero correlation. Full credit starts at 0.90.

title: Gabi's Coloring Book
grading: The task page publishes the submission format and scoring details. Sign in to check whether this archived round accepts submissions.

statement.detail: Gabi's coloring book. Distinguish photos from drawings and cluster images by object.

data.detail: Train images, test images, and a starter kit with submission examples are listed.

materials.submission: Use the sample CSV and the organizer’s submit form. An account is required, and replay access may depend on the round.

metric: Medium accuracy earns up to 20 points. Adjusted Rand index for object groups earns up to 80.

title: Alzheimer's prediction

links.label: Official statement, data download, and judge

grading: Full model credit starts at AUC 0.90. Reproduce the first two calculations from the released training table. Use MLCompete’s original judge for the held-out score.

statement.detail: Use supplied benchmark tables to calculate two age-based statistics and predict the diagnosis label.

data.detail: The organizer download contains labeled train.csv and test.csv. The statement defines the demographic and clinical columns.

materials.submission: Write subtaskID,datapointID,answer. Return a probability for the third subtask.

metric: Two exact checks (10 and 15 points) and ROC AUC (75 points).

english.note: Use Download problem files on the judge page for the matching task version.

title: Cartoon classification

links.label: Official statement, data download, and judge

grading: Hold out some labeled images for accuracy checks. Use MLCompete’s original judge for the held-out score.

statement.detail: Classify four visual styles in the Disney Festival of Cartoons benchmark.

data.detail: The original pack supplies labeled train.json, unlabeled test.json, and the images directory.

metric: Accuracy, with full credit at 95% and zero below 20%.

english.note: Use Download problem files on the judge page for the matching task version.

title: Spam detection

links.label: Official statement, data download, and judge

grading: AUC of 0.95 earns the full classifier points. Use a held-out labeled split for practice. Use MLCompete’s original judge for the held-out score.

statement.detail: Compute the two requested email statistics and predict a spam probability.

data.detail: The downloadable ZIP contains labeled train.csv and unlabeled test.csv.

materials.submission: Write subtaskID,datapointID,answer, with one row per email and subtask.

metric: Exact checks (10 and 15 points) and ROC AUC (75 points).

english.note: Use Download problem files on the judge page for the matching task version.

title: Train delays

links.label: Official statement, data download, and judge

grading: Use a labeled holdout and score in minutes with the original error scale. Use MLCompete’s original judge for the held-out score.

statement.detail: Predict how many minutes each train will be delayed from the supplied trip features.

data.detail: The task pack contains train.csv with delay_minutes and test.csv without that target.

metric: Mean absolute delay error. Full points at MAE ≤ 5 and zero at MAE ≥ 20.

english.note: Use Download problem files on the judge page for the matching task version.

title: Language identification

links.label: Official statement, data download, and judge

grading: Score accuracy on a labeled holdout with intact language names. Use MLCompete’s original judge for the held-out score.

statement.detail: Identify the language of each supplied piece of text.

data.detail: The original task download includes labeled train.csv and test.csv with SampleID and Text fields.

metric: Classification accuracy. Full points at ≥ 0.98 and zero at ≤ 0.90.

english.note: Use Download problem files on the judge page for the matching task version.

title: Song popularity

links.label: Official statement, data download, and judge

grading: Use a labeled holdout and apply the published point scale to the MAE. Use MLCompete’s original judge for the held-out score.

statement.detail: Predict the popularity of a song from its audio features and metadata.

data.detail: The organizer pack includes song train.csv and test.csv. Only train.csv has the popularity target.

metric: Mean absolute error. Full points at MAE ≤ 5 and zero at MAE ≥ 20.

english.note: Use Download problem files on the judge page for the matching task version.

title: Movie scores

links.label: Official statement, data download, and judge

grading: Use a labeled holdout for MAE, then apply the published point curve. Use MLCompete’s original judge for the held-out score.

statement.detail: Predict the numeric score of movies and series from the supplied metadata.

data.detail: The organizer download has train.csv with Score and a test.csv with title, type, description and year.

metric: Mean absolute error. Full points at MAE ≤ 0.65 and zero at MAE ≥ 2.0.

english.note: Use Download problem files on the judge page for the matching task version.
